I use October–December 2022, the latest completed quarter before the post, to operationalize the ongoing allocation claim. Marcus supplied no reporting period.
This is an industry allocation claim, not a claim about an individual company's accounts, so metric_scope is null.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable allocation records for the target period show that half or less went to large language models.
